module.title: Self-gravity (FFT and multigrid Poisson solvers), FFT infrastructure and driven turbulence
module.expensive_path: Global 3-D FFTs (forward and inverse, with block-to-pencil remaps) or multigrid V-cycles every step for the potential, and the FFT-based Ornstein-Uhlenbeck driving in the turbulence problem.
module.rationale: An elliptic solve coupled to the hydro step is different work from the hyperbolic update, and both Poisson backends plus the driving share the FFT/multigrid infrastructure.
excluded: Cosmic-ray diffusion also uses multigrid but is separate physics; see not_packaged
hazards: FFTW3 required; fft and turb tests are written for MPI (-mpi, mpirun)
turb_3d uses a seeded random driving; determinism across ranks must be verified in the survey
